title: Lecture on the East and South China Sea Disputes — Higher Command Course
description: Spoke to officers from friendly foreign countries on disputes in the East and South China Seas at the maiden Higher Command Course of the Indian Naval War College in Goa.

title: China's Western Theatre Command: An Operational and Tactical Assessment
description: Lecture on the PLA Western Theatre Command, covering its operational and tactical posture, at the Army Training Command in Shimla.

title: New Frontiers in China's Military Organisation — ICS Wednesday Seminar
description: Invited Wednesday Seminar lecture on the PLA's dissolution of the Strategic Support Force and the creation of the Information Support, Cyberspace, and Aerospace Forces. Chaired by M.V. Rappai; an official executive summary was published by ICS.

title: Book Release: Taming The Dragon — A Manifesto for a New Modus Vivendi with China
description: Panel discussion at the Pune International Centre launch of the co-authored volume proposing a new modus vivendi framework for India's China policy.

title: Special Panel: Current Discourses in Chinese Studies — 18th AICCS
venue: All India Conference of China Studies
description: Panellist on the state of the field of Chinese studies in India at the Institute of Chinese Studies' flagship annual conference.

title: Lecture on PLA Intelligent Multi-Domain Operations
description: Guest lecture to senior officers on the PLA's intelligentised multi-domain operations concept.

title: Australia Policy Ecosystem Delegation
description: Part of a DFAT-supported delegation of Bengaluru women in tech-policy engaging with policymakers, industry leaders, and researchers across Australia's policy ecosystem.

title: China in the World Conference 2026
description: Presented "A Parallel Security Order: China's Defence Industrial Base and Economic Weaponisation" (with Amit Kumar) at the China in the World conference, hosted by Doublethink Lab in Taipei.

title: Brussels Indo-Pacific engagement
description: Engagements in Brussels coinciding with the Brussels Indo-Pacific Dialogue 2025 (1-2 December).
